inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL analytics query reuses one ordered window specification for RANK, PERCENT_RANK, CUME_DIST, and NTILE distribution calculations.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored compensation-band report. One named department-and-score window is reused for rank, percentile rank, cumulative distribution, and quartile assignment over fixed employee scores; the source tables, labels, values, and reporting context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Departments 11 and 22 have five and three fixed employees. Scores include a tie in department 11; employee ID is the final window ordering key so every distribution value is deterministic.
determinism_notes: Department IDs, employee IDs, scores, named-window ordering, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE compensation_scores (employee_id INT PRIMARY KEY, department_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT department_id, employee_id, score, RANK() OVER score_order AS score_rank, ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER score_order, 4) AS percentile_rank, ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER score_order, 4) AS cumulative_distribution, NTILE(4) OVER score_order AS quartile FROM compensation_scores WINDOW score_order AS (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY score ASC, employee_id ASC) ORDER BY department_id, score ASC, employee_id ASC
